content.text:
I fixed `v-for` over a `shallowReactive` array so it passes each item through as it is. Before the fix, `renderList` saw that the array was reactive and wrapped every item with `toReactive`. That turned the plain object into a deep reactive proxy, so `item.aaa` was unwrapped from a ref to a string. That's why the issue saw `"string"` inside the loop and `"object"` outside it.

The change is in `packages/runtime-core/src/helpers/renderList.ts`: items are now only wrapped when the source array is reactive and **not** shallow (checked with `isShallow`). Deep reactive arrays behave as before.

The existing `renderList` tests pass (7/7). I didn't add a test for the shallow case, and I didn't run the issue's reproduction directly.
